outcome.Summary: Created semver/semver.go implementing Semantic Versioning 2.0.0: Version struct, Parse (optional leading v, strict validation of MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, pre-release and build identifiers: no leading zeros in numeric parts/numeric pre ids, no empty identifiers, only [0-9A-Za-z-]), String (canonical, no v prefix), Compare (numeric core, pre-release precedence rules: no-pre > pre, numeric vs alphanum, ASCII lexical, shorter list lower; build metadata ignored), and MustParse. Added semver/semver_test.go covering valid/invalid parses, canonical string round-trips, the spec's canonical precedence ordering, equality with differing build metadata, and MustParse panics. Verified with `go vet ./...`, `gofmt`, and `go test ./... -count=1` — all pass.
